name: io.github.mbilisphe13/momo
title: MTN Mobile Money
description: Request and track MTN Mobile Money payments across Africa. Sandbox-locked by default.

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_API_USER
environmentVariables.description: API user UUID. In the sandbox, momo_provision_sandbox_user creates one.

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key paired with the API user

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_TARGET_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: sandbox, or a production country such as mtnghana. The host is derived from this.

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_ALLOW_PRODUCTION
environmentVariables.description: Required with a production target. Must be 'i-understand-this-moves-real-money'.

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_PRODUCT
environmentVariables.description: Which MoMo product the subscription key is for

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency. The sandbox only settles in EUR.

environmentVariables.name: MOMO_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on a single payment request, in major units
